$comment: What was read, and at which revision, for every column of the comparison table in README.md.
The table is the one thing this project ships that makes claims about other people's software,
and it goes wrong without anything breaking. `npm run smoke` already checks how OLD it is;
this file makes it checkable whether the other side has MOVED since we looked, which is the
question that actually decides whether a cell still holds. `npm run table-sources` compares
each `sha` against that project's current HEAD and names the columns worth re-reading.
Adopted from csitte.at, whose rule is 'no matrix cell without our own evidence' — they record
the foreign HEAD before mirroring a row. On 2026-08-26 their recorded SHA for taylorwilsdon
and ours matched, which is how a claim about a third party should be confirmable at all.
`shaBasis` is deliberately part of the record: `recorded` means the SHA was read at the time
of checking, `inferred` means it was reconstructed afterwards from the commit history (safe
only when the repository did not move between the check and the reconstruction). Never write
`recorded` for a SHA nobody wrote down — that is the exact habit this file exists to break.

columns.note: No repository to pin: a hosted server documented on a web page, so only the date carries. Read the tool reference itself, not the Cloud blog. Still Developer Preview; ten tools, by name: create_draft, get_message, get_thread, label_message, label_thread, list_drafts, list_labels, search_threads, unlabel_message, unlabel_thread. No send, trash, filters or unsubscribe.

Cells established 2026-08-26 by reading auth/scopes.py (TOOL_SCOPES_MAP and TOOL_READONLY_SCOPES_MAP are keyed by SERVICE, not by tool), main.py (set_enabled_tools receives the service list), core/tool_registry.py (read-only filters the registered tools), and the README for the tier names — the same SHA csitte.at recorded independently that day. Moved to this revision on 2026-08-29 by reading the DELTA, not by re-reading the cells: 57 commits, and the only one touching a source of ours is a shutdown finally-block in main.py, nowhere near the scope derivation. No new Gmail tool, no snooze, no query-driven bulk, no unsubscribe action — every cell holds. Re-read in full at the next comparison round.

Cells date from the 2026-08-16 round (12 Gmail tools, triageInbox heuristics, the AES find is in downloadProxy.ts and is NOT token encryption). The SHA was not written down then; it is reconstructed from the commit history, where this commit (2026-08-10) was already HEAD on the day of the check and still is. Re-read and mark as `recorded` at the next round.

The Structured-outputs cell was corrected on 2026-08-25 by reading src/tools/output-schemas.ts (one tool, download_email, called the 'first wave'). This commit is from 2026-07-27 and has been HEAD since; later pushes were Dependabot branches, so what was read then still describes this revision.
